findings.issue: Pending shared-directory save read catalog labels from mutable caller meta instead of its record snapshot
findings.evidence: Three regressions fail against old implementation; fixed implementation also passes actual FullBackup label validation
findings.triggerLimit: Persistence-boundary race reproduced with pending IndexedDB plus caller model mutation; normal busy-locked UI click path was not demonstrated

findings.issue: Settled failed save blocked Academic Year navigation even after rollback
findings.evidence: Real save rollback regression plus workspace/connection/installation/blocked/loading/draft guards

findings.issue: Displayed present count excluded late pupils despite report contract
findings.evidence: present + late + late:0 + late:10 yields four present, with late retained as subset; canonical attendance tally reused

findings.issue: Empty historical roster was labelled completed attendance
findings.evidence: Valid session with roster=[] now displays review-needed status; roster and records remain unchanged

findings.issue: Copied detailed activity report omitted homework note visible in HTML
findings.evidence: Screen and copied text regression checks retain the same explanation

findings.issue: Question-bank exam/import validation allowed year 0000 outside calendar/native date contract
findings.evidence: Creation and JSON import reject year zero/invalid days and retain valid years 0001..9999; source bank unchanged
findings.compatibility: Previously imported/API-created archives containing year 0000 now fail validation explicitly. Native form never generated year 0000; invalid archives are neither rewritten nor deleted automatically.

findings.issue: Session-history pagination browser suite absent from release/CI
findings.evidence: Added dedicated existing suite to release gate and contract assertion; final output separately passes 240 checks

browserCountNote: Summed browser suites repeat a common harness; this is not a count of unique business scenarios.
releaseCommandNote: Final complete release gate includes the added session-history suite. A previous attempt found one stale browser expectation excluding late pupils from present; that expectation was corrected against BUSINESS-RULES, then the complete final gate was rerun. Generated assets remained unchanged throughout the final gate.

dependencyGraph.changes: No lockfile/dependency install or update performed

boundaries: Synthetic data and disposable browser profiles only; personal school/question-bank files were not opened or changed.
No Android/iPhone physical-device keyboard, native picker/share sheet, printer or native Word acceptance performed.
No publication, push, schema migration, dependency update or authentication/licensing feature introduced.
No claim that static review or passing tests proves absence of every possible defect.
